description: Lint every edited file with oxlint (PostToolUse) and block edits that turn an oxlint rule off (PreToolUse). Both hooks run on Deno with a scoped flag set: read + run + env, never net.

hooks.command: command -v deno >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'oxlint-guard: deno not found on PATH - install Deno (https://deno.land) so the lint guard can run' >&2; exit 1; }; exec deno run --quiet --allow-read --allow-run --allow-env "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/guard-lint.ts"

command -v deno >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'oxlint-guard: deno not found on PATH - install Deno (https://deno.land) so the config guard can run' >&2; exit 1; }; exec deno run --quiet --allow-read "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/guard-config.ts"
